omittedAssetPaths.reason: Upstream docs/asset-policy.md states this format table is not covered by the repository licence. Leonida integration requires user-supplied external tables.

integrationStatement: Vendored and integrated locally into tudorek12345/Leonida. This is not an upstream endorsement.

localChanges.purpose: Load user-supplied BCPack format tables without redistributing the upstream non-licensed blob. Preserve the builtin() call API, validate the external source boundary and bound file reads; test missing, malformed and synthetic valid files.
Remove the omitted table exception from tracking and asset checks; document the external-file requirement.
Refuse hook installation into the parent Git repository and scope both working-tree and staged policy checks to the vendored subtree, with temporary-repository tests.

Keep current-executable PE probes on Windows and add hand-written synthetic PE parser/import coverage for other hosts. Run the upstream RVA-overflow regression on the portable fixture and rename the upstream export fixture helper to avoid a name collision; production parser code matches the pinned upstream.
Remove the upstream trailing blank line so the imported patch passes git diff --check; table content is unchanged.

Keep D3D12 presentation transitions valid when the source is already in COPY_SOURCE. Add an opt-in Series S diagnostics workaround that presents the sole 4K color target for two-plane menu frames when 1080p has no color draws.
Log the host adapter and presentation failures. Reuse one CPU texture read buffer across serialized submissions and handle scratch allocation failure without aborting the runtime.
Allow scripted diagnostics to use the keyboard stand-in gamepad on hosts with an XInput controller connected.
Report live graphics allocation sizes alongside process commit and DXGI segment use during loading and at the first host texture allocation failure.
Preserve structured SRV stride and element offsets when lowering scalar byte-addressed loads to DXIL. Exercise a load straddling two elements with a synthetic WARP fixture.
Specialize compute image operations for bound R32 integer UAV views while preserving root signature bindings. Verify exact integer texture writes with a synthetic WARP dispatch.
Preserve explicit null SRV and UAV types and bind null CBVs without allocating empty scratch buffers.
Reuse matching placed textures and covering shadow buffers. Cap idle snapshots so copies used by world rendering do not accumulate after submissions finish.
Capture a bounded number of frames after dark presentation transitions so the loading screen and first world frames can be inspected without predicting frame numbers.
Bind translated raw root SRVs through descriptor tables with buffer bounds, including null bindings for missing root addresses.
Report process-loopback PCM peaks so audio routing and silent gameplay can be distinguished in diagnostic runs.
Keep device-removal diagnostics from allocating buffer shadows, report placed and unordered descriptor layouts, and avoid direct reads of guest constant memory that can be unmapped concurrently.
Bind unordered views of address-backed textures to the same host image used by shader reads and select integer compute variants for these views.

Serialize native shader and DXIL-validator tests with one test-only lifetime guard after a parallel access violation in Windows CI, matching the pattern reported in Marvisak/VIctory issue 181. Keep every test and assertion; normal runtime behavior and concurrency are unchanged.

convergedLocalFixes: The native D3D12 root-parameter test fixture correction is now upstream; use its exact implementation.
